The '''Walleye''' is a [[fish]] that can be caught in the river (in [[Pelican Town]] or [[Cindersap Forest]]), the [[The Mountain|mountain Lake]], and the [[Cindersap Forest]] pond during [[Fall]] when it is [[Weather|raining]]. It can also be caught in [[Winter]] if a [[Rain Totem]] is used. It can also be gifted by a [[Animals#Pets|pet]] cat with max [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]]. It can randomly be found in [[Garbage Can]]s during Fall and Winter, or at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{tprice|105}}. If the player chooses the [[Farm Maps#Riverland|Riverland Farm]] or the [[Farm Maps#Forest|Forest Farm]], Walleye can also be caught in the farm pond.

Walleye is most common in the Cindersap Forest pond. Every cast in the pond during raining Fall days has a 32% chance of hooking a Walleye.

Walleye can be caught regardless of weather, time, or season using [[Magic Bait]].

==Map==
Walleye can be found in the river, [[The Mountain|mountain lake]], and [[Cindersap Forest|forest pond]] during [[Fall]] when it is raining.

==Tailoring==
Walleye can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Fishing Vest]].  [[File:Shirt157.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a yellow dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Fish Pond==
Walleye can be placed in a [[Fish Pond]], where they will reproduce every 3 days. The initial pond capacity is 3 fish, but the capacity can be increased to 10 by completing three quests. The only possible output is yellow Walleye [[Roe]].

The '''Rainbow Trout''' is a [[fish]] that can be caught in the river (in [[Pelican Town]] and [[Cindersap Forest]]) and the [[The Mountain|mountain lake]] during [[Summer]] during sunny [[weather]]. It can also be gifted by a [[Animals#Pets|pet]] cat with max [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]]. It can also randomly be found in [[Garbage Can]]s during Summer, or at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|65}}. On Summer 20th and 21st during the [[Trout Derby]] festival, Rainbow Trout can be caught in the Cindersap Forest during the entire day and regardless of weather. The fish can also be caught during Trout Derby without the normal restrictions in [[Farm Maps]] with Cindersap Forest fish, such as the Riverland, Hilltop, Forest, and Meadowlands farms. Rainbow Trout can be caught regardless of weather, time, or season using [[Magic Bait]]. ==Map== The Rainbow Trout can be found in the river and the mountain lake. {{Map|270|43|loc2x=200|loc2y=150|loc3x=120|loc3y=150}} ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |dislike=Robin,Maru,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Emily,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Krobus |neutral=Demetrius,Sebastian,Linus,Pam,Elliott,Willy,Leo |hate=Pierre,Evelyn,Haley }} ==Bundles== Rainbow Trout is not used in any [[bundles]]. ==Recipes== {{Recipes|header}} {{:Maki Roll|RecipeRow}} {{:Quality Fertilizer|RecipeRow}} {{:Sashimi|RecipeRow}} {{:Trout Soup|RecipeRow}} {{Recipes|footer}} ==Tailoring== Rainbow Trout can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[Tailoring|Fish Shirt]]. [[File:Shirt158.png|24px]] It can also be used as an orange dye in the dye pots located in [[Haley]]'s and [[Emily]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==Fish Pond== Rainbow Trout can be placed in a [[Fish Pond]], where they will reproduce every 2 days. The initial pond capacity is 3 fish, but the capacity can be increased to 10 by completing three quests. The primary output is orange Rainbow Trout [[Roe]]. However, more valuable items are possible starting at population 9, including a 0.09% daily chance of producing a [[Prismatic Shard]]. The '''Crab''' is a [[fish]] that can be caught using a [[Crab Pot]] in any [[Crab Pot#Saltwater|saltwater]] body of water. It can also be dropped by a [[Rock Crab]] (15% chance) or [[Lava Crab]] (25% chance) when slain. It can also be gifted by a [[Animals#Pets|pet]] turtle with max [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]], or randomly found at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|100}}. Five can be purchased from [[Elliott]]'s [[Desert Festival#Villager Shops|shop]] at the [[Desert Festival]] for {{Price|30|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]]s each. Like all fish caught from the crab pot, it cannot be eaten unless it is used in a [[Cooking]] recipe or [[Smoked Fish|smoked]].

:''See also: [[Legend II]]. For the achievement, see [[Achievements#Achievements list|Achievements]].''
The '''Legend''' is a [[fish]] that can be caught during [[Spring]] in [[the Mountain]] lake during rainy [[weather]]. It is one of the five [[Fish#Legendary Fish|Legendary Fish]], so it can only be caught once per [[Saves|save file]], or once per player in [[Multiplayer]].

The special requirements necessary to hook a Legend are:<ref name="requirements"/>
* [[Fishing#Fishing Skill|Fishing level 10]], either naturally or using Fishing [[Buffs]].
* The bobber must be located in water with a [[Fishing#Distance from Land|distance from land]] of 4, ''i.e.,'' it must be at least four tiles away from any land (including bridges) in every direction.
** The Legend can appear one tile closer to land if the bobber lands in [[Fishing#Bubbles|bubbles]].
** The region of the lake near the large submerged log meets this requirement, as suggested in ''[[Lost Books#Secrets of the Legendary Fish|Secrets of the Legendary Fish]]''. However, there are other locations in the lake that also work.

When all of these requirements are met, each cast has a 10% chance of hooking a Legend (20% if using a [[Curiosity Lure]]). Contrary to the information provided by ''[[Lost Books#The Fisherman, Act II|The Fisherman, Act II]]'', none of the other Legendary Fish need to be caught first.

Although the Legend cannot be hooked again after it is caught, it is still possible to obtain multiple Legends in singleplayer. The player can catch up to 3 by using [[Challenge Bait]], or an infinite number by [[Pans|Panning]] in the correct [[#Map|tiles]] with the [[Forge#Enchantments|Fisher enchantment]] (so long as the player has not already caught the Legend normally). 

The Legend can be caught regardless of weather or season using [[Magic Bait]].

The '''Lava Eel''' is a [[fish]] that can be caught during all times and seasons in [[the Mines]] on the 100th floor and at the [[Forge|Volcano Caldera]]. It is the only fish that can spawn in lava.

In the Mines, the chances of hooking a Lava Eel depends on fishing level and equipment of the farmer, as well as the [[Fishing#Distance from Land|distance from land]] of the fished tile. The base chance of hooking a Lava Eel is 1.8%, which is increased by 0.32% per Fishing Level and 0.08% per tile from land. This is increased by a further 4% if a [[Curiosity Lure]] is equipped, and by 8% if [[Targeted Bait|Lava Eel Bait]] is equipped.<ref name="mines_rates"/> For example, with a Fishing Level of 10 and 5 tiles from land, the chance of hooking a Lava Eel is 5.4%. This increases to 9.4% with a Curiosity Lure equipped, to 13.4% with Lava Eel Bait equipped, and to 17.4% with both a Curiosity Lure and Lava Eel Bait equipped.

At the Volcano Caldera, the percent chance of hooking a Lava Eel is equivalent to 10 times the [[Fishing#Distance from Land|distance from land]] of the spot fished, assuming the [['Physics 101']] painting was not caught. For example, there is a 50% chance to hook a Lava Eel if the bobber lands 5 tiles from land.<ref name="forgechance" />

Of the non-[[Fish#Legendary Fish|legendary fish]], it is the fish with the highest sell price and the second highest difficulty fish (after [[Octopus]], tied with the [[Scorpion Carp]]).

==Tailoring==
Midnight Squid can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the {{Name|Fishing Hat|class=inline}}. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a blue dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Fish Pond==
Midnight Squid can be placed in a [[Fish Pond]], where they will reproduce every 3 days.  The initial pond capacity is 3 fish, but the capacity can be increased to 10 by completing three quests.  Instead of producing [[Roe]], squid ponds produce [[Squid Ink]].
